answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. Claiming a slot requires burning a deposit equal to twice expected 30-day earnings. A beacon audits slots at dawn: the audited agent must prove live control in one hour, or the deposit stays burned and the slot closes. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 deposits, a gap as wide as a canyon between profit and cost. An honest agent pays once, holds its slot to the horizon, and earns undiluted rewards.
